annotations.title: Request a human attestation with evidence

description: Request that a human observes and attests an observable fact (with photos, timestamps and a signed statement). Not a notarisation. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 49 per attestation in the pilot region (+ EUR 0.50/km outside). Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

evidence_required.description: Optional: what evidence you need (photos, video, document copies).

fact_to_attest.description: The exact fact to observe and attest.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

time_window.description: When the observation should take place.
